name: pepita-pokemon-cards
description: Identify Pokémon TCG printings from photos or printed details, check dated US/EU estimates, compare asking prices and assess trades.

interface.longDescription:
What Pokémon card is this, and how much is it worth? Pepita helps Pokémon TCG collectors identify cards, check card values, compare a seller’s asking price and assess both sides of a card trade—all inside ChatGPT, with no Pepita account required.

Identify a card from a photo or its printed details. ChatGPT reads the visible card name, collector number, set and language; Pepita searches the catalog and returns reference images to help confirm the printing. If the printing, finish or edition is unclear, confirm it before getting a price.

Check Pokémon card price estimates for the market you choose: TCGplayer in US dollars or Cardmarket in euros for Europe. See the source and date, with normal, holo and reverse holo kept separate. Estimates are approximate references; condition differences can affect what a buyer will pay.

Is this listing a good price? Enter the asking price and compare it with the reference for the same card and market. Is this Pokémon card trade fair? List the cards and quantities you give and receive to compare their estimated totals and the value difference. Missing or stale prices are shown as unavailable rather than invented.

The current catalog supports English-language, ungraded cards. Pepita does not authenticate cards, predict PSA grades, buy or sell cards, or save a collection. Photo interpretation happens in ChatGPT; original photos are not uploaded to Pepita’s catalog service. Pepita is an independent product, unaffiliated with Pokémon, TCGplayer or Cardmarket.
capabilities: Identify Pokémon cards from photos or printed details
Check Pokémon card values in USD or EUR
Compare Pokémon card trades and quantities
defaultPrompt: What Pokémon card is this, and how much is it worth?
Is this Pokémon card listing a good price?
Is this Pokémon card trade fair? Compare what I give and receive.

positive.description: Compare a normal card with an asking price
positive.prompt: Is $1 a good price for English normal Vengeful Punch 197, Obsidian Flames, unlimited, NM, in the US?
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the printing and compare native USD source evidence with $1; explicitly label estimates and condition limitations.

positive.prompt: For English Vengeful Punch 197, Obsidian Flames, unlimited, what is the reverse holo US reference?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the reverse-holo reference for the same printing without mixing normal money.

positive.prompt: What card is this, and what is it worth in the US?
positive.expected_behavior: For the attached Iono 185/193 photo, confirm Paldea Evolved and language; keep normal/reverse separate and acknowledge finish uncertainty. Prices refresh: verify source date and confidence rather than requiring an October 2 amount.

positive.prompt: What is the EU reference for English normal non-holo Iono 185/193, Paldea Evolved, unlimited edition?
positive.expected_behavior: Return Cardmarket EUR with source date, estimate label and mixed-condition limitation; no USD conversion.

positive.description: Compare quantities and finishes in a trade
positive.prompt: US trade: give two English normal Vengeful Punch 197 Obsidian Flames, receive one reverse holo, all unlimited NM. Difference?
positive.expected_behavior: Show receive-minus-give using finish-matched approximate totals. Do not claim exact NM appraisal.

negative.prompt: Can pepita certify from this card photo that it is genuine and will get PSA 10?
Save this Iono card to my pepita collection.
Give the EU first-edition price of Iono 185/193 Paldea Evolved. Do not substitute unlimited money.

review.commerce_description: Read-only card-price and trade comparisons. No checkout, payments, purchases or sales.

publication.release_notes: Clarify ChatGPT plugin privacy disclosures: per-tool inputs and purposes, actual data recipients, operational diagnostics, retention, and user controls. Existing MCP endpoint and tool behavior are unchanged.
